title: Building Strategy For Bitcoin-Hesitant Investors: Willis
content:
Cyber Hornet ETFs co-founder and CEO Michael Willis tells Bloomberg his firm’s 75/25 strategy, blending equities with Bitcoin exposure, is designed to give investors a more familiar, stable entry point into crypto. Willis adds that the firm is moving its Bitcoin exposure from futures to spot and plans to launch additional ETFs using the same methodology. He joined the discussion on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" with Katie Greifeld and Scarlet Fu.


 (Source: Bloomberg)
